risks.risk: Wrong platform claim (seller says PS6, but photos appear PS4/PS5-era). Buyer may receive incompatible discs.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of one disc case showing the exact platform label (PS4/PS5) and the disc itself (front/back) with the title visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed compatible with PS6 (treat as PS4/unknown compatibility).

risks.risk: Disc condition (scratches/drive errors) not shown; 'slightly used/brand new' cannot be verified remotely.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip of the disc being inserted and played (or a console test screen) for at least 1–2 titles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used and potentially faulty (worst case: assume buyer may need replacement/returns).

risks.risk: Exact titles and quantity are unclear (photo shows many cases but not all titles are readable).
risks.proof: Ask for a numbered list of titles + quantity, and a photo where each case title is readable (or a video panning across all cases).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a mixed set with uncertain titles/quantity.

risks.risk: Region/compatibility (some discs are region-locked or require specific console versions).
risks.proof: Ask for close-ups of the disc label and case region/compatibility markings (e.g., 'Region Free' or region code).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the platform label on at least one case (PS4 vs PS5) and a close-up of the disc label.
Short video test: insert and load 1–2 discs on a working console, showing the game starting.
A numbered list of all titles included + total quantity, matching the photo.
response.reason: The seller’s key claim about 'Ps6' is contradicted by what’s readable in the photo, and disc condition/compatibility cannot be verified remotely. Without proof, a safe worst-case price cannot be confidently matched to the correct item.
